_about: The ONE order an agent's state is listed in — the web's «에이전트 상태» (Today · 홈 · 관제, apps/web/src/lib/agent-state-list.ts `stateRank`) and the desktop app's bottom strip (desktop-electron/src/ui/board.ts `sortBoard`). Both repos keep this file byte for byte the same and read the vectors below in their own tests — change one side and they turn red. Story 5038 (C8 · PO 11-27: «웹 stateRank가 기준, 띠를 맞춤»).

meaning.limit: a usage limit the agent rests at (the web's «사용 한도» · «한도로 쉬는 중»; the strip's rows that wear those words)
meaning.error: the session stopped with an error (and, on the strip, a row whose Sprintable tools failed)
meaning.hand: a person's hand: a permission request · an input question · a macOS prompt · a first-screen question
meaning.idle: waiting for the next work · just started
meaning.never_ran: the agent has no session yet (the web's list only)

web.rule: stateRank(word, limitShown, askingFirstScreen) = the index of the row's group in `order`.

vectors.name: any word that reads as a limit (limitShown) goes first

strip.rule: The strip first splits its rows into its three groups («손 필요» · «일하는 중» · «그 밖» — story 4889 · 4907), then orders the rows INSIDE each group by `order`. ONE deliberate difference from the web: «연결 끊김» (unknown) stays in the strip's «손 필요» group (it has counted as a hand since 4889 — the bar's «손 필요 N» does not change), so there it sorts LAST of the group, where the web lists it after idle.

vectors.name: an error row sorts above a permission request
permission · macOS prompt · input keep their order
a macOS prompt before an input question
an input question before a lost session (inside «손 필요»)
just started sorts with the idle ones, below «작업 중» — not with working
